# msgpack

```go
import "github.com/eugeneliukindev/gashe/codec/msgpack"
```

Package msgpack is a gashe.Codec based on MessagePack: smaller and faster to decode than JSON.

Values stored with it are binary, so Cache.IncrBy cannot read them; keep counters under keys that are only touched by IncrBy.
